name: Itaike na Tenshi-tachi ~Akumu no Byoutou~
original_name: いたいけな天使たち　～悪夢の病棟～
source:
Hospital full of desires of rich and powerful people. Girls are being insulted here in exchange for promises of bright future or money. But playing with innocent girls proved not enough. The clients  started to catch and drug enthusiastic idol fans to make them dirty their paragons with their own hands.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
医院里充满了权贵的欲望。女孩在这里受到侮辱，以换取光明未来或金钱的承诺。但事实证明，与无辜女孩玩耍还不够。客户开始抓捕狂热的偶像粉丝并对其下药，让他们亲手玷污他们的偶像。
